column1: # Held-out 08: Tokyo - captain-supplied held-out plan (sourced online), not in corpus. 25 rows.
# Ground truth: 08-captain-japan.txt (5-day Tokyo plan PDF, pdftotext raw; hand-written 2026-08-31)
# line<TAB>accepted areas (pipe-separated, lowercase; NONE = sending no area is fully correct)<TAB>note
# Rows are PLACE stops only (lines a traveller would tap expecting a Maps result).
# Labels were written BEFORE the parser was run on this document (held-out protocol).
# Area principle: document-faithful, judged as a reasonable Tokyo local; harm criterion (would the
# composed Maps query mislead?), per data/cairn-parser-areas/report.md section 1.
# Excluded lines: 1/6/15/25/28 are DAY headers; 27 is the traveller's own question, not a tappable stop; 32 is blank.
# 'tokyo' is accepted on Tokyo-proper rows whose venue name is distinctive (no chain stops exist in this doc);
# it is NOT accepted for DisneySea (Urayasu, Chiba) or Narita (Chiba).
